Chapter 677: Chapter 12 Eleventh-Rank Evolvers (Please Subscribe)

In the higher echelons of Human Civilization, the Galaxy Master was highly hopeful to advance into Tier 11.

But high hopes were still just hopes, and at least the Galaxy Master was not yet a Tier 11.

He wasn’t even Tenth Rank.

Under such circumstances, how could Nalan, an Eleventh-Rank Evolver, treat the Galaxy Master with such a demeanor?

Black Star Lord and others were secretly astonished.

The Galaxy Master was a favored junior of Xia Qin Supreme Being, a fact that wasn’t a secret to anyone.

...

However, Human Civilization spoke solely through strength, and even the progeny of a Supreme Being wouldn’t be valued by other Evolvers without significant achievements.

Having stepped into Tier 11, Nalan had essentially reached the pinnacle of Human Civilization; he had no need to place much consideration on the Galaxy Master’s potential.

Even if everything went smoothly in the future, the Galaxy Master would probably be at the same level as him.

As for being a Supreme Being? The public only believed that the Galaxy Master had the potential to challenge to become a Supreme Being, but no one could assure this outcome.

Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master, while watching Lin Yuan chatting amicably with Nalan, couldn’t help but think.

The fact that the Galaxy Master garnered such attention from a distinguished Eleventh-Rank Evolver suggested there might be secrets about him that they were unaware of.

…

Elsewhere.

Nalan secretly transmitted, “Galaxy Master, had it not been for your defeat of me in our discussion over the Rule of Time, I might not have broken through so quickly.”

Nalan was deeply grateful to Lin Yuan.

After all, his breakthrough did indeed have a lot to do with the Galaxy Master.

Furthermore, during that discussion, Nalan realized Lin Yuan’s true potential.

Being merely Ninth Rank yet reaching such an understanding of the Rule of Time, what could he achieve in the future?

The outside world merely believed that the Galaxy Master had a great chance to step into Tier 11, but Nalan firmly believed that as long as nothing unexpected happened, the Galaxy Master would definitely make it to Tier 11.

And even if he reached Tier 11, the Galaxy Master could swiftly ascend to the peak of Tier 11.

Even within Tier 11, there was a vast difference. Some Eleventh-Rank Evolvers hadn’t even fully grasped the Rule of Time.

Some Eleventh-Rank Evolvers not only mastered the Rule of Time but also achieved the integration of the Rule of Time and Space Rules, and there were those who grasped special methods that allowed them even to contend against Supreme Beings.

“Even without me, with the Vice Tower Master’s realm, you likely would have broken through soon,” said Lin Yuan immediately.

Nalan’s breakthrough was partly due to Lin Yuan’s provocation, but primarily it was his own sufficient foundation.

The latter was the main reason.

“It’s different,” Nalan shook his head.

With his pride, if not for being defeated by a Ninth Rank like Lin Yuan, he wouldn’t have undergone such a transformation in his mindset.

“Regardless, I, Nalan, owe you, Galaxy Master a favor; if you need help in the future, just speak,” said Nalan solemnly.

The favor of a Tier 11 life being was immeasurably valuable.

Living long as a Tier 11, and mastering the Rule of Time, could achieve a sort of alternative eternity, having such a favor, who within Human Civilization would dare provoke Lin Yuan?

The two exchanged a few more pleasantries.

Then more guests came to congratulate Nalan.

“You go ahead,” Lin Yuan, recognizing the situation, left and returned to his seat with Black Star Lord and the others.

“Galaxy Master, you and Nalan, are you close?” Black Star Lord couldn’t help but ask.

Nalan’s exceptionally special treatment towards Lin Yuan had piqued Black Star Lord’s deep curiosity.

Lustrous Star Master also stared intently at Lin Yuan.

She too was curious about why Nalan had treated Lin Yuan that way.

“Okay, I guess. We’ve met a few times before,” Lin Yuan thought for a moment; he had indeed only met Nalan a few times.

“Just a few meetings, and he treats you like this?” Black Star Lord shook his head.

To him, a Tenth Rank Grade A Evolver, Nalan merely smiled and casually replied with a few words.

But towards Lin Yuan, that fervent enthusiasm was obvious to any fool.

The differences were far too great.

“That I don’t know,” Lin Yuan shook his head, choosing not to disclose his sparring with Nalan.

One reason was to protect Nalan’s dignity.

The other was that he also didn’t want to expose his own insights into the Rule of Time.

Seeing Lin Yuan’s response, Black Star Lord didn’t push further.

The conversation among them quickly shifted to another topic.

“A celebration for an Eleventh-Rank Evolver; I don’t know how many years it’s been since Human Civilization last held one.”

“There are so many powerhouses here this time…”

Black Star Lord chatted with Lin Yuan and others while observing the guests coming and going around them.

Lin Yuan nodded in agreement.

Not long ago, there were also many strong figures who attended his sister Lin Yi’s wedding.

But compared to the current celebration, it naturally fell far short.

At least at the wedding, apart from the Xia Family’s Eleventh-Rank Ancestor, other Eleventh-Rank Evolvers didn’t personally attend but sent representatives to offer their congratulations.

And now, one legendary Eleventh-Rank Evolver after another made their appearances.

“Galaxy Master.” A white-haired elder with a smile approached.

“Mr. Luo,” Black Star Lord and others immediately greeted with solemn expressions.

This white-haired elder, with the surname Luo, was the vice president of the Biluo Association and a Tenth Rank Grade A Evolver.

The Biluo Association is an incredibly profound human civilization force, second only to the Nine Great Evolution Towers, with its president being an Eleventh-Rank Evolver.

And amongthose in the Eleventh Rank, he is an extremely powerful entity.

“Mr. Luo,” Lin Yuan greeted as well.

“I’ve long heard the name of the Galaxy Master,” Mr. Luo, the white-haired elder and vice president of the Biluo Association said with a friendly smile, “In this era of our human civilization, thanks to the emergence of the Galaxy Master, it will become incredibly brilliant.”

No matter what heights Lin Yuan achieves in the future.

Merely by breaking a series of myths during his Eighth and Ninth Ranks, he is enough to be recorded in the annals of human civilization and worshipped by countless future citizens.

“I’m just lucky,” Lin Yuan replied modestly.

In fact, Mr. Luo was right, at least within this era, within a span of a hundred thousand years, Lin Yuan’s fame is absolutely one of the greatest.

…

In other regions of the planet, guests according to their statuses were seated in different areas.

The guests who could enter the core planet were all not simple; each had indispensable status and background.

“Who is that, sitting with a group of Tenth Rank Grade A powerhouses? Even the vice president of the Biluo Association has gone over to initiate a conversation?”

“Don’t you know who that is? He is the Galaxy Master, the strongest genius in the history of our human civilization. Now, Nalan, the vice tower master is hosting an Eleventh-Rank celebration; perhaps, in the future, it will be the Galaxy Master hosting the Eleventh-Rank celebration.”

“The Galaxy Master is currently only at the Ninth Rank, far from the Eleventh Rank.”

“I believe, given the Galaxy Master’s talent, stepping into the Eleventh Rank is just a matter of time.”

“Indeed, the Galaxy Master is too young. Being so young and yet achieving so much, he is destined to stand at the peak of our human civilization.”

…

Many guests were very optimistic about the Galaxy Master, believing he had a strong chance of advancing to the Eleventh Rank, considering how briefly it’s been since his rise.

“Galaxy Master, if you find the time, you are welcome to visit our Biluo Association. Our president has mentioned you several times,” Mr. Luo, the white-haired elder and vice president of the Biluo Association, said before preparing to leave.

“Definitely, if the opportunity arises,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The most renowned aspect of the Biluo Association is the control of a medium-sized secret realm known as ‘Biluo Secret Realm’.

This realm harbors some special indigenous lives, and its many specialties are greatly beneficial to Evolvers.

Countless Evolvers yearn to enter the Biluo Secret Realm, but they lack the qualifications.

Now the vice president of the Biluo Association personally invited Lin Yuan, evidently, the Association’s president places high importance on the Galaxy Master.

On the core planet, Ninth Rank Evolvers are common, but Tenth Rank Evolvers somewhat catch people’s attention.

Just then.

A commotion suddenly erupted in the distance.

“The Xuanyuan Clan Leader has arrived.”

Both the Black Star Lord and the Lustrous Star Master looked up.

A man with black hair, dressed in a white robe, quietly descended onto the planet.

“The Xuanyuan Clan Leader?”

“The leader of the Xuanyuan Family?”

“One of the strongest Evolver families in our human civilization?”

“Also the family established by a direct descendant of a Supreme Being from our human civilization?”

The numerous guests started whispering, as several Supreme Beings of human civilization presided over the Nine Great Evolution Towers and also had their families.

And the Xuanyuan Family is one of the most profound families in human civilization; its ancestor was a Supreme Being of human civilization.

“Xuanyuan Clan Leader,” greeted Nalan, the vice tower master, personally.

The Xuanyuan Clan Leader himself is an Eleventh-Rank Evolver and had already thoroughly understood the Rule of Time, adding to his considerable authority, even Nalan didn’t dare show any disrespect.

Lin Yuan carefully observed the Xuanyuan Clan Leader; the Black Star Lord did likewise.

It was quite rare to get a close look at an Eleventh-Rank Life who had mastered the Rule of Time.

You should know that a large part of Eleventh-Rank Lifes have not mastered the Rule of Time.

“When will I master the Rule of Time…” the Black Star Lord couldn’t help but murmur with a sigh.

For someone like him, a Tenth Rank Grade A, stepping into the Eleventh Rank was somewhat confident, but mastering the Rule of Time? That felt much more uncertain.

Not every Eleventh Rank Powerhouse could master the Rule of Time.

And mastering the Rule of Time holds great significance for any being, as it can slow the passage of their own time, allowing them to live much longer.

You should know, surging toward the Ultimate for Eleventh Rank Powerhouses depends a lot on opportunity.

Perhaps this era may not provide the chance to surge toward the Ultimate, but if one survives to the next era, then the opportunity may arise.

So, living long enough means infinite possibilities.

“Indeed,”

Lin Yuan also reflected quietly.

“Mastering the Rule of Time, for us at this moment, is still quite challenging,” the Lustrous Star Master reasoned pragmatically.

“Indeed,”

the Black Star Lord pondered and nodded.

They weren’t even at Tier 11 yet, so what about mastering the Rule of Time?

Learning to run before even learning to walk? Isn’t that a bit overly ambitious?

“Let’s not think too much, Galaxy Master,”

the Black Star Lord said to Lin Yuan.

Unbeknownst to him, Lin Yuan sitting beside him, was only a step away from mastering the Rule of Time.
